findings.evidence: GET /api/materials rows have additionalProperties=false and no sha256 property; actual MaterialManager.list also omits it. Both Node reader and Python firewall erroneously require this field.
findings.fix: Join real owned persisted 工作区/材料/index.json by material_id to actual UI rows, verify name/path/unit/status/version/source hash and later claimed scope exact; no expected-config fallback or adding fields to API.

findings.evidence: Node posts taskCreate before requestScope; Python task selection requires data.session_id==self.session_id but self.session_id remains None until scope prepare.
findings.fix: Preserve real UI ordering and bind FIRST valid actual Native Session ID at owned task selection, then require same identity for scope/currentR/claim; no all-case fallback or weaker cross-session guard.

findings.evidence: DSH SessionEventMap user/message data is UserMessage directly; assistant/tool messages wrap data.message. eventMessageText incorrectly always unwraps data.message.
findings.fix: Explicit event-type-aware authoritative data shape; retain exact canonical user text/R and all assistant/tool checks, no permissive fallback.
